title: Increased Police Patrol
description: Use this service request when a citizen would like to request additional police patrol in their neighborhood or a specific Dallas area. If there are specific days and times please provide. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

detailsForm.intro: ***Be advised that this service request is not monitored on a 24-hour basis. If you have an emergency and require immediate assistance, please call 911.***

observedQuestions.question: What is the nature of your request?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Nature supplied; contact = No; Details Continue reached Contact

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for additional police patrol in a Dallas neighborhood or area.
actions.why: To request additional police patrol in a neighborhood or specific Dallas area; include specific days and times when relevant. The request form asks for the nature of the request.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Increased Police Patrol" requests does not apply to emergencies requiring immediate assistance because it is not monitored on a 24-hour basis. If immediate assistance is needed for an emergency, then call 911.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Increased Police Patrol"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Increased Police Patrol"

actions.tagline: Call 911 for an emergency needing immediate assistance.
actions.why: For an emergency needing immediate assistance; the Dallas 311 request form states that Increased Police Patrol is not monitored on a 24-hour basis.
